shared_elements: repeated small figurative symbols arranged in lines
shallow relief-carved glyph-like forms on a flat stone surface
curved/loop and arc shapes among the signs
justification: Both surfaces show rows of repeated relief-carved sign-like motifs organised into horizontal registers separated by lines, which gives a loose shared scheme of inscription-like banding. But the specific content differs: A shows a dense, varied repertoire of small naturalistic pictorial signs (birds, limbs, vessels, seated forms) packed in many closely spaced lines, while B shows only a few large, crude, angular chevron/zigzag and hoop-like emblems with sparse animal-like shapes, a much simpler and more schematic vocabulary with no correspondence in individual motifs.
